flows.name: Reject an unconfirmed Acumatica import
steps: Invoke the deployed Acumatica entrypoint without manual confirmations
Observe process termination before provider or database initialization
flows.expectedOutcome: No automatic Acumatica import can write data

flows.name: Keep JobPlanner dispatch-only
steps: Inspect the main workflow event contract
Require an explicit yes input and both runtime confirmations
flows.expectedOutcome: JobPlanner cannot start from a time-based event

claims.description: Acumatica has no source scheduler owner and its direct entrypoint rejects unconfirmed execution before initialization
JobPlanner has no schedule event and requires a deliberate confirmed manual dispatch
Frontend contracts and product copy do not claim automatic Acumatica synchronization
